CHAPTER.CAPTION: Psalm of David
CHAPTER.VERS: Save me O Jehovah for no godly person is left. Faithful people have vanished from among the sons of men.
People speak lies to one another. They speak with flattering lips and with double-heart.
Jehovah will destroy every flattering lip and every bragging tongue
They say: »We will overcome with our tongues. With lips such as ours, who can be our master?«
»Because oppressed people are robbed and needy people groan, I will now arise,« says Jehovah. »I will provide safety for those who long for it.«
The words of Jehovah are pure, like silver refined in a furnace on the earth and purified seven times.
O Jehovah, you will protect them. You will keep each one safe from those people forever.
The wicked walk about when immorality increases among the sons of men.
